context: Tests whether the agent classifies a Go-built Debian-major bump as safe-mechanical and cites the specific safe pattern ('Go-built images moving Debian / RHEL major') from the rubric.

checklist.name: Classification is safe-mechanical
checklist.description: advice.md classifies the bump as safe-mechanical (not requires-migration, license-aware, interim-caution, or not-recommended).

checklist.name: Cites the Go-builder safe pattern
checklist.description: Indicators or Notes section references 'Go-built images moving Debian / RHEL major' (or a clearly equivalent quote from the rubric's safe-mechanical patterns list).

checklist.name: Cites static-linking / CGO_ENABLED=0 evidence
checklist.description: The advice cites the context's statement that the binary is statically linked (CGO_ENABLED=0), or references the rubric's 'statically linked' criterion for safe-mechanical.

checklist.name: Recommended action present and sensible
checklist.description: Recommended action says, in effect, 'apply mechanically' or 'safe for chart-supply-refresh --allow-bumps safe to consume'. Not 'pause for review'.

checklist.name: No fabricated CVE references
checklist.description: The advice does NOT cite specific CVE identifiers. CVEs were not part of the input context; mentioning them is fabrication.
